description: This file defines utility functions related to voice wake command processing, including token normalization, trigger detection, and command extraction based on voice transcripts.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token by trimming whitespace and punctuation, then converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the provided trigger phrases, after normalization.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command string from transcript if it matches trigger conditions and length requirements.
